bottom_info.title: More Information
bottom_info.info: The model does not include any fossil-fuelled generation, which in Austria is mainly natural gas. For a non-100% renewable energy system, the residual load or the load gap (load minus renewable generation) must be covered by either fossil-fuelled power generation or imports — neither of which is part of this model. Therefore, the emission footprint of the system cannot be calculated directly. However, the Load Gap parameter gives an upper bound for the required natural gas-based power production. Multiplying it by approximately 0.2 yields an estimate of the CO₂ footprint in Mt.
bottom_info.disclaimer: This is a highly simplified model to understand system scales. It does not represent real-world system behavior, as several factors are neglected. For example, solar generation timeseries are not very well represented with historic data from ENTSO-E. Check the corresponding section on Limitations on the {link}.
